description: Build a Boutique basket for the person and get the checkout link. Pass the products from search_products (id or slug) with quantities, and subscribe: true for subscribe-and-save where the person wants it. Returns a summary to read back to the person, each line at the price checkout charges, anything that could not be added and why, the delivery options, checkout_url and cart_link (the same basket as a short link, priced again when opened). Give the person checkout_url or cart_link: they enter a UK delivery address and pay on Stripe themselves. Nothing is charged or stored by this tool; never pass or ask for card details.

product.description: Product id, slug, variant id or product URL, from search_products.

subscribe.description: Subscribe and save, charged every month until cancelled. Only if the person asked for it.

variant_id.description: Size or flavour, when product is the product id of an item that has options.

name: create_basket
title: Prepare a Boutique basket
